name: Kansai
source: Passionate, hot-headed, and impulsive, Kansai loves the idea of strong, brave leaders, and tries to take command of the group. Even when things go bad due to his carelessness, he has a certain charm that makes it impossible to hate him. He sees Reycho as his arch-rival, causing sparks to fly at times. On his chest, Kansai wears the "Leader's Badge," which is only given to a true leader. As you can tell from his appearance, he loves baseball.
